description: Commodity Quantity Restrictions - Per-ship max holds and per-transaction limits

tests.name: Baseline: No limits configured (default behavior unchanged)
tests.description: Verify existing commodities work unchanged when max_holds_per_ship is NULL and base_max is 0

steps.desc: Ensure market.trade_qty_base_max is 0 (default, no per-transaction cap)
Warp to a lawful port with ORE
Buy 10 ORE (should succeed - no per-ship or per-tx limit on existing commodities)
Verify player now has at least 10 ORE

tests.name: Per-ship max: Buy commodity within limit
tests.description: Verify buy succeeds when commodity.max_holds_per_ship is set and current+qty <= max

steps.desc: Create commodity ALT with max_holds_per_ship=1 and make it tradable

args.sql: INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility, max_holds_per_ship) VALUES ('ALT', 'Alien Technology', 0, 50000, 100, 1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO porttype_commodity_rules (porttype_id, commodity_code, can_buy, can_sell, base_price_mul, qty_max_mul) SELECT pt.porttype_id, 'ALT', true, true, 100, 100 FROM porttypes pt WHERE pt.is_stardock = true LIMIT 1 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
SELECT quantity FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id = {{ship_id}} AND commodity_code = 'ALT'

tests.name: Per-ship max: Reject buy when limit exceeded
tests.description: Verify buy rejects with ERR_COMMODITY_MAX_HOLDS_EXCEEDED when current+qty > max

steps.desc: Setup: Use same player/commodity as B1 (1 ALT already held)

args.text: Assumes ALT commodity exists with max_holds_per_ship=1 from prior test

steps.desc: Attempt to buy 1 more ALT (total would be 2, exceeds limit of 1)

tests.name: Per-ship max: Capacity resets after sale
tests.description: Verify buy succeeds again after selling commodity back to zero

steps.desc: Setup: Player has 1 ALT from B1

args.text: Assumes player still has 1 ALT in cargo

steps.desc: Sell 1 ALT back to port (inventory returns to 0)

args.sql: SELECT COALESCE(quantity, 0) as qty FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id = {{ship_id}} AND commodity_code = 'ALT'
SELECT quantity FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id = {{ship_id}} AND commodity_code = 'ALT'

tests.name: Per-transaction max: Buy within limit
tests.description: Verify buy succeeds when qty <= calculated transaction max

steps.desc: Set market.trade_qty_base_max to 10 (base max per transaction)
Warp to a port with ORE

tests.name: Per-transaction max: Reject buy when limit exceeded
tests.description: Verify buy rejects with ERR_COMMODITY_TX_QTY_EXCEEDED when qty > tx_max

args.text: Assumes base_max=10, qty_max_mul=100 for ORE, so tx_max=10

steps.desc: Attempt to buy 15 ORE (15 > tx_max of 10)

tests.name: Per-transaction max: Multiplier applied correctly
tests.description: Verify qty_max_mul affects transaction limit (e.g., mul=50 halves the limit)

steps.desc: Create commodity MOD with qty_max_mul=50 (half of default 100)

args.sql: INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility) VALUES ('MOD', 'Modified Commodity', 0, 1000, 50) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; UPDATE porttype_commodity_rules SET qty_max_mul = 50 WHERE commodity_code = 'MOD' OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM porttype_commodity_rules WHERE commodity_code = 'MOD') = 0 AND porttype_id = (SELECT porttype_id FROM porttypes WHERE is_stardock = true LIMIT 1);

steps.desc: Buy MOD with qty=5 (should succeed - equals tx_max)
Attempt to buy MOD with qty=6 (exceeds tx_max of 5)

tests.name: Regression: Baseline disabled (config=0)
tests.description: Verify old behavior: no per-transaction cap when market.trade_qty_base_max=0

steps.desc: Buy large quantity of ORE (should succeed - no per-tx limit when base_max=0)

tests.name: Combined limits: Per-ship AND per-transaction together
tests.description: Verify both limits enforced simultaneously (e.g., ALT: max_holds=3, tx_max=2)

args.sql: INSERT INTO commodities (code, name, illegal, base_price, volatility, max_holds_per_ship) VALUES ('COMBO', 'Combined Test', 0, 5000, 100, 3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO porttype_commodity_rules (porttype_id, commodity_code, can_buy, can_sell, qty_max_mul) SELECT pt.porttype_id, 'COMBO', true, true, 50 FROM porttypes pt WHERE pt.is_stardock = true LIMIT 1 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

steps.desc: Buy 2 COMBO (within both limits: 0+2<=3 ship max AND 2<=2 tx max)
Buy 1 COMBO (within both limits: 2+1<=3 ship max AND 1<=2 tx max)
Verify player has 3 COMBO (at ship max)

args.sql: SELECT quantity FROM ship_cargo WHERE commodity_code = 'COMBO' AND ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM ships WHERE player_id = {{player_id}} ORDER BY ship_id DESC LIMIT 1)

steps.desc: Attempt to buy 1 more COMBO (would fail both: 3+1>3 ship max AND 1>tx_max if no inventory, but ship max hits first)
